appDescription.message: Convert the current page to Markdown, read it in a reader-style view, and download the .md file.

optTitle.message: Include the page title as a heading

sourceSnapshot.message: Recorded state with the most content

badgeFallback.message: article detection failed; converted the whole page

noticeNotFound.message: No conversion result was found. The browser may have been restarted, or the result may have been dropped because newer conversions took its place. Please convert the page again from the toolbar button.

optionsLead.message: Use the toolbar button (or Alt+Shift+M) to convert the current page to Markdown. If text is selected on the page, only the selection is converted.

optionsSectionTruncated.message: For pages whose content gets cut off

optMonitorTitle.message: Record the moment the page had the most content

optMonitorDesc.message: Watches how much body text a page has from the moment it opens, so that content later removed or collapsed by JavaScript can still be converted. This needs permission to read all sites.

optFetchTitle.message: Also fetch the original HTML from the server and compare

optFetchDesc.message: Loads the page URL once more during conversion (from the browser cache when possible) and compares the HTML as it was before JavaScript ran. This adds one request.

optWaitDesc.message: Waits until DOM changes settle before converting (helps with lazy loading).

optionsOutputNote.message: The title heading, source link, and front matter can be turned on and off from "Display settings" in the viewer.

statusNoPermission.message: Recording is stopped because permission to read all sites was not granted.

statusRecording.message: Recording. It takes effect the next time you open a page.

statusPermissionDenied.message: Could not enable this because permission was not granted.

errInternalPage.message: This page (a browser internal page) cannot be converted.

errStorePage.message: Extension stores cannot be read by extensions, so this page cannot be converted.

errNoResult.message: Could not obtain a conversion result.

errScriptLoad.message: The conversion scripts could not be loaded.

errNoArticle.message: No article content could be extracted from this page.
